answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works when each agent stakes a refundable deposit that a peer committee can slash once duplicated content hashes surface. A single quartz pebble can stand in for an entire canyon of gravel, and one verified identity can likewise inflate into many fakes only at real cost. Rate limits alone miss that, but a staked deposit gives an honest pulse to every claim: fake accounts burn money before they earn any trust.
